blocks.name: USB_INPUT
blocks.purpose: Provide USB-C connector and ESD protection for the 5V VBUS and D+/D- data lines from the host.

blocks.name: POWER_INPUT
blocks.purpose: Distribute 5V VBUS power and ground to the board's power conversion and downstream blocks.

blocks.name: LDO_3V3
blocks.purpose: Regulate the 5V input down to a clean 3.3V rail for the RP2040, flash, and other logic.

blocks.name: MCU_RP2040
blocks.purpose: Host the RP2040 microcontroller (QFN-56) and its required decoupling, reset, and boot configuration.

blocks.name: QSPI_FLASH
blocks.purpose: Provide external QSPI flash memory for program and data storage, connected to the RP2040's QSPI interface.

blocks.name: CLOCK_12MHZ
blocks.purpose: Provide the 12 MHz crystal oscillator reference clock to the RP2040.

blocks.name: GPIO_CASTELLATED
blocks.purpose: Route the RP2040's GPIO pins to castellated edge pads for external connection.

connections.description: USB D+ and D- differential data lines
3.3V regulated rail for the flash memory
QSPI bus (CS, SCK, D0-D3) between RP2040 and flash
12 MHz crystal oscillator input to the RP2040
GPIO signals routed to castellated edge pads

assumptions: The board is powered solely from USB VBUS (5V) with no external power input (defaulted).
The 3.3V rail is generated by a single LDO regulator from the 5V USB input (defaulted).
The RP2040 is used in its default boot configuration with QSPI flash as the primary boot source (defaulted).
The 12 MHz crystal is a standard parallel-resonant crystal with the RP2040's internal oscillator circuit (defaulted).
Castellated GPIO pads expose a subset of the RP2040's GPIO pins, with the exact pin selection deferred to the architecture stage (defaulted).
USB-C is used in a device-only configuration (no USB-PD or dual-role power) (defaulted).
The board does not include an external reset button or user LEDs unless required by the architecture stage (defaulted).
